test_initialize_creates_admin: test that POST initialize creates an admin user and sets an access token cookie on first boot
test_initialize_rejected_when_admin_exis: test that a second initialize call returns 409 when an admin already exists in the system
test_initialize_password_validation: test that the initialize endpoint rejects short or common passwords with a 422 status code
test_setup_status_before_after_initializ: test that setup-status returns needs_setup true before initialization and false after admin creation
test_initialize_public_access: test that the initialize endpoint is publicly accessible without requiring an authentication cookie
